headline: Highest risk is data leakage from Airflow’s broad egress into a course repo with no documented isolation; other pairwise risks are low or absent.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared channel is documented, so direct prompt injection is not evidenced. However, airflow has broad network egress and data-engineering-zoomcamp is a repo/course artifact that could be manually copied into workflows, creating a weak manual bridge. The pairwise pathway is therefore possible but not default and the blast radius is limited.
conditions: IF an operator manually copies content from data-engineering-zoomcamp into airflow task definitions or prompts, injection becomes possible.
IF a shared filesystem or clipboard is introduced between the two, the pathway strengthens.
mitigations: Avoid copy-pasting untrusted repo text into Airflow DAGs.
Keep the two agents on separate workspaces.
Add a review step before any Airflow task consumes repo content.
Use allowlisted templates for task text.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging for imported content.

B_data_leakage.rationale: airflow has broad network egress, but profile B shows network_egress:none and neither profile lists sensitive data classes touched. With no shared workspace or secrets handling documented, leakage is not a default pairwise outcome. The main concern is accidental export if operators place sensitive files into Airflow inputs.
conditions: IF sensitive files are placed into Airflow-managed inputs, Airflow can transmit them outward.
IF the course repo is used as a source of private data, leakage risk increases.
mitigations: Do not store secrets in shared project folders.
Keep sensitive datasets out of Airflow DAG directories.
Review outbound destinations before enabling any Airflow task.
Use dummy data for course materials.
requires-engineering: enforce egress allowlists.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: No overlapping write surfaces, OAuth scopes, or shared mutable resources are documented for airflow and data-engineering-zoomcamp. Airflow is runnable:false in the profile, and B exposes no write-capable surfaces. The pairwise conflict pathway is therefore not supported by the profiles.
conditions: IF a shared writable directory is later introduced, conflict risk would need reassessment.
IF either profile gains write access to the same mutable resource, the verdict changes.
mitigations: Keep resources read-only where possible.
Separate any future writable workspaces.
Document ownership for mutable assets.
Avoid concurrent edits to shared files.
requires-engineering: add locking for shared state.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Airflow can operationalize outputs, but data-engineering-zoomcamp is a course repo rather than an autonomous agent, so there is no documented B-side action-taking authority. The main pathway is manual: if operators treat repo content as authoritative and feed it into Airflow, errors can cascade, but this is not a default automated chain.
conditions: IF repo content is copied into Airflow tasks without verification, downstream mistakes can propagate.
IF Airflow is configured to execute generated instructions from the repo, cascading error risk rises.
mitigations: Require human review of imported instructions.
Test DAGs on non-production data first.
Label course material as non-authoritative.
Add validation checks before execution.
requires-engineering: add schema and policy gates.

E_compliance.rationale: No residency, certification, retention, or regulated data classes are documented for either airflow or data-engineering-zoomcamp. Without a stated compliance mismatch, there is no evidenced compliance breach pathway in this pair.
conditions: IF regulated data classes are introduced into either agent, compliance must be re-evaluated.
IF residency or retention requirements are later specified, the verdict may change.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of both tools.
Document data handling rules before deployment.
Review vendor terms if sensitive data is added.
Separate training material from production data.
requires-engineering: add compliance controls and audits.
